chunks: And the tall date-palms, having spathes piled on pile.

key_terms.بَاسِقَاتٍ: Tall, high, or lofty (referring to the height of the date palms)
key_terms.طَلْعٌ: The spathe or early fruit cluster of the date palm
key_terms.نَضِيدٌ: Piled on top of one another, layered

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the date palm in the description of the Resurrection in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a metaphor for the ease of resurrection, where the date palm's layered fruit production (tal' nadeed) signifies Allah's ability to recreate life in abundance and order. The imagery underscores the divine power to raise the dead not just once, but with renewed vitality, reflecting the concept of bodily resurrection (ba'th al-jasad) central to Shia theology. This natural sign serves as a tangible proof for the skeptics of the Hereafter, linking the physical world's fertility to spiritual renewal.
